resources.string: A floating UP / DOWN / DNT signal checker for Binance.US spot markets. It reads public candles and never places trades.

The combined score ranges from -10 to +10: 1-minute early momentum ±2; 5-minute primary trigger ±6; 15-minute structure confirmation ±2. UP triggers at or above the selected positive DNT threshold, DOWN at or below the negative threshold, and DNT inside the neutral zone or whenever required market data is missing. The threshold is adjustable from ±2 to ±6. Public market data does not need an API key. This app is a manual decision aid, not financial advice or an automatic trader.
